info.title: Kognai Coder — spec to patch
info.description: Kognai Coder: turn a natural-language job spec into a unified-diff-like patch, a rationale, and suggested test names. Deterministic template/heuristic engine (no LLM). Pay-per-call via x402 (0.01 USDC on Base).

post.summary: Patch a job spec into a unified diff with tests
post.description: Send a job spec or failing-test description; receive {patch, rationale, tests, applied}. Charged per call: 0.01 USDC on Base mainnet via x402 (scheme exact, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0x27EbD1DDCB6607bE8641784A1bf654623Fc8290e). An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with the machine-readable x402 v2 challenge in the body and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Add ?dry=1 to preview the generated patch for free (unpaid sample mode).

parameters.name: dry
parameters.description: 1/true returns the generated patch without payment (preview mode).

spec.description: Job spec, failing test, or desired change, e.g. 'add retry with exponential backoff to fetchUser'.

target.description: Optional file path hint, e.g. 'src/api/user.ts' or 'app/users.py'; the extension selects TypeScript vs Python.

rationale.description: Why the change is shaped this way.

applied.description: Always false: the diff is returned, never applied.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 v2 challenge in body and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header
